name: workflow-environment-factory
description: Run Codex inside resettable repository and Issue-to-PR Cases with objective validation.

interface.shortDescription: Practice and score Codex on your own resettable workflows.
interface.longDescription: Adds bounded local simulator tools and task instructions for Cases generated by Workflow Environment Factory. The plugin cannot alter validators or scores.
interface.defaultPrompt: Complete the active Workflow Environment Factory Case using only its confirmed workspace and allowed local simulator tools. Do not claim a score; the factory validates the final state.
